ManaMune 0.1.0 - test build
===========================

Scales your character's breast bones with how much mana you have left.

REQUIRES Customize+ (https://github.com/Aether-Tools/CustomizePlus).
Without it the plugin loads but says so and does nothing.


Install
-------

1. Close the game.

2. Open this folder:

       %APPDATA%\XIVLauncher\devPlugins\

   (paste that into the Explorer address bar)

3. Make a new folder inside it called   ManaMune

4. Copy these three files into it:

       ManaMune.dll
       ManaMune.json
       ManaMune.deps.json

   The result should be:
       %APPDATA%\XIVLauncher\devPlugins\ManaMune\ManaMune.dll

5. Start the game. Type  /manamune


Use
---

Full mana gives one scale, empty mana gives another, sliding between the two
as you cast. Defaults are 1.0 at full and 0.6 at empty.

The two sliders are MULTIPLIERS on whatever your own Customize+ profile
already sets - a 1.4 shape at half mana becomes 1.4 x 0.8, not 0.8. Your
profile is read and carried along, so nothing else you have scaled is lost
while this runs.

Bones: vanilla j_mune_l / j_mune_r by default. IVCS and pectoral bones are
tick boxes. Note the IVCS breast bones sit UNDER the vanilla ones in the
skeleton, so ticking both multiplies rather than widens.

"Only on jobs that spend mana" is on by default. Every job reports 10000 MP
these days, so on a Samurai this would otherwise sit pinned at the full-mana
scale forever.


Worth knowing
-------------

- It is LOCAL ONLY. Nobody else sees it - not through Mare, not through
  anything. Temporary Customize+ profiles are not synced. You see it on your
  own character, on your own screen.

- If you switch Customize+ profiles while it is running, press "Re-detect
  profile". While ManaMune is applying, Customize+ reports ManaMune's own
  profile as the active one, so a switch cannot be spotted automatically.
  Zoning, changing job and logging in all re-detect on their own.

- Turning it off or removing the plugin puts your normal profile straight
  back. It never writes to your saved Customize+ profiles.


If something goes wrong
-----------------------

Type  /manamune debug  - it prints the Customize+ API version, which profile
it detected underneath, the current mana percent and the bones it is driving.
It also dumps the full profile list to the log, which you can read with /xllog.

Send that back along with what you saw.
